top_signals.title: Warren presses Lutnick over UAE access to sensitive U.S. tech after Trump crypto investment
top_signals.summary: Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Howard Lutnick to explain eased UAE export controls after UAE-linked entities invested in the Trump family’s crypto venture.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Mastercard, Borderless test shared identity checks for stablecoin transfers
top_signals.summary: Mastercard and Borderless are exploring ways to bring more trust into cross-border stablecoin transfers through the payment processing giant’s Crypto Credential framework.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Japan and U.S. begin working-level talks on host nation support
top_signals.summary: The U.S. government during preliminary talks indicated that it would ask Japan to increase its host nation support.
